Hawaiian Burger
By: Omaha Steaks
Published: Thursday, June 14, 2012 - 10:05am

Ingredients




Ground beef
Bacon
Pineapple slices
Mozzarella cheese
Sautéed Onion
Lettuce
Teriyaki sauce
Sweet Hawaiian bread

Preparation

1 Make a sweet and tangy sauce by combining the teriyaki with the excess pineapple juice. Marinade both the pineapple slices and beef patties in the mixture. 2 After the patties are cooked, place sliced mozzarella on top to melt. 3 You can either cook sliced onions with the meat or drape them on top as toppings. Lettuce and bacon make nice toppings, and if you are feeling daring, you can add shredded coconut to sweeten the meal. 4 Hawaiian bread completes this sweet and tangy sandwich with a fruity twist.
